title: Nashville Downtown Riverfront Condo -Honky Tonks
description:
Welcome to Nashville , our renovated condo is located in the heart of downtown , overlooking the Cumberland River across from the Titans/ Nissan stadium . Walk to the famous honky tonks on Broadway , Sounds stadium, Bridgestone arena for concerts or to cheer on the Nashville Predators hockey team . We hope you enjoy your stay in Music City !!!  
* 4 night min. For CMA week 2025-2030 and  all CMA weeks  . Message me first before booking.

The space
Enjoy a cup of coffee and watch the barges coming down the river . Free  Covered parking .No pets allowed

Guest access
We have a laundry facility , pool and workout room .

Other things to note
We have a book inside the unit for great tips and suggestions on where to eat or visit in our great city. No Pets allowed.
